name: SPIKE Prime / Pybricks · experimental
description: Hub con firmware Pybricks 3.6.1+ (compatible con 4.0). La app solo carga programas por Bluetooth, no instala firmware. Pendiente de prueba física.

en.Hub con firmware Pybricks 3.6.1+ (compat: Hub with Pybricks 3.6.1+ firmware (compatible with 4.0). The app only uploads programs over Bluetooth; it does not install firmware. Physical testing pending.
en.Un motor o sensor Powered Up por puerto;: One Powered Up motor or sensor per port; these are not GPIO. Block references share the device, not two physical devices.
Also stops the program by default.
Open code.pybricks.com in Chrome or Edge.
en.Conecta el hub por USB y sigue el asiste: Connect the hub by USB and follow the wizard to install the Pybricks firmware.
en.Vuelve a RobotBlocks y conecta el hub po: Return to RobotBlocks and connect the hub by Bluetooth.
en.Para volver al firmware de LEGO, conecta: To return to the LEGO firmware, connect the hub to the official LEGO Education SPIKE app and accept the firmware update.
en.También puedes abrir Pybricks Code y ele: You can also open Pybricks Code and choose Restore official LEGO firmware in the tools menu.
en.Pybricks Code: instalar o restaurar firm: Pybricks Code: install or restore firmware
